title: delete_passage
description: Remove a passage. When other passages link to it, the server never silently dangles — it emits a clarification asking how to handle incoming links.

handle_incoming_links.description: 'ask' triggers a clarification when incoming links exist. 'remove_link_markup' strips the [[...]] syntax from each source passage. 'leave_dangling' keeps the markup (will fail validate_story).

clarification_triggers: handle_incoming_links='ask' AND incoming links exist: ask remove_link_markup | leave_dangling | cancel
name is the story's start_passage: ask which passage becomes the new start before deletion proceeds
